title: RouteResolver
summary: Resolve authorized routes for a URL no known route matches.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Return the routes to add, or none when the path is unknown or denied. Rejections are not remembered as denials. Wrap a resolver with withRouteDiscovery to use it as a router's discover option.
sections.code:
const resolve: RouteResolver = async (url, { signal }) =>
  (await fetch(`/routes?path=${url.pathname}`, { signal })).ok ? [admin] : [];
